blocking_finding.why_no_reviewer_can_fix_it: task_review_merge_gate.py derives merge authority from the canonical row of the task id on the head branch, and it fails closed on a missing row by design. scripts/ai-status.sh approve binds an approval to a task row; there is no row for L12-POST-4380-GAP-DISPATCH-20260729 to approve or reopen. Approving this review task (SUP-L12-POST-4380-GAP-REVIEW-20260729) does not feed the gate for a different task id, so an approval here would be a no-op that falsely reads as progress. Reopening is equally unavailable for the same reason: reopen also targets a row.
remediation_options: Register a canonical row for L12-POST-4380-GAP-DISPATCH-20260729 bound to PR #4382, then run a normal exact-head review cycle on the refreshed content.
Retire PR #4382 and re-land the packet under a task id that has a canonical row, per the pattern SUP-L12-STALE-PR-RETIRE-20260729 already covers.
Retire PR #4382 outright as superseded, since Waves 0/A/C are largely archived and the packet's actionable surface has shrunk to Wave D.

why_the_base_was_refreshed.trigger: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py returned status=waiting, rebase_status=rebase_required for PR #4588.
why_the_base_was_refreshed.integrator_detail: PR #4588 needs a refreshed head to land on dev; the approval of 93e73039bbb84603917bca824aa37d0ffc24c4b6 would not cover it. Owner refreshes the branch and the assigned reviewer re-approves the new head.
why_the_base_was_refreshed.mechanism: For a review_before_merge PR the integrator never force-pushes an approved head. It requires origin/dev to already be an ancestor of the approved exact head so it can smoke that immutable commit. origin/dev advanced past the approved head, so that ancestry test failed.
why_the_base_was_refreshed.action_taken: Merged origin/dev forward into the task branch. A rebase was deliberately not used, because rebasing a task branch whose delivery is an evidence manifest rewrites the commits that carry that manifest into the PR diff.
why_the_base_was_refreshed.consequence: The exact-head approval of 93e73039bb no longer binds the standing head. A second exact-head review is required; this is a base refresh, not new review content.
